name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA adapters, narrow symbol/PCB workflows and seven engineering skills.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills cover EasyEDA Pro control, schematic design, PCB layout, component libraries, manufacturing release, design review and extension development. Exact version-pinned typed API adapters distinguish public subsets, native equivalents, vendor HTTP equivalents, blocked implementations and documented omissions. Discovery is not execution support. The exact legacy read tuple is connected-read-admitted and future mismatches fail closed; legacy general writers remain runtime-disabled. Three pinned declaration snapshots cover 835 distinct methods, including concrete omissions for installed 3.2.209 stubs and missing backend handlers. EasyEDA 3.2.209 has an eleven-tool catalog: API reference, local discovery, status, bounded Math/Unit/Environment and language/viewport readers, tab-count/active-identity/shortcut observations, public footprint catalog lookup and ordinary launch. The catalog lookup requires explicit network confirmation and runs without the app or SDK execution. No project opening, design-content operation, Save or recovery route is registered there. Source/offline checks are separate from connected validation. Older profiles retain their exact eligible metadata workflows and disposable validation routes with original ownership and persistence proof; these do not transfer to 3.2.209. General writers and ratline capture integration remain unfinished. Ordinary launch uses the existing profile, may restore tabs and persist data, and does not prove isolation. Ambiguous attempts remain consumed. No unrestricted JavaScript, arbitrary command, Save/Discard choice, force exit or blind retry is exposed. Historical journals cannot recreate ownership. Consult the skills and coverage inventory for exact scope.
defaultPrompt: Validate the EasyEDA bridge without bypassing compatibility gates.
Inspect the admitted EasyEDA project with exact readers and managed evidence.
Apply the requested typed design change and verify it after saving and reopening.
